parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Before calling this operation, ensure that the instance is in the Running state. You can check the current status of the instance by checking the DBInstanceStatus field returned by the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。调用本接口前，实例须处于Running状态，您可以通过调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口返回的DBInstanceStatus字段确认实例当前状态
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shard or mongos node in the sharded cluster instance.

If the instance is a sharded cluster instance and this parameter is not specified, the entire sharded cluster instance is restarted
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Shard节点ID或Mongos节点ID。

当实例类型为分片集群实例时，如不传入本参数，则重启分片集群实例
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The time when the instance is restarted. Valid values:
0: Restarts the instance immediately.
1: Restarts the instance within the O&M window
parameters.help_zh:
重启实例的时间点。取值：
0：立即切换。
1：在可运维时间段内切换
parameters.name: switch_mode

parameters.help_en:
The type of the node to be restarted in the sharded cluster instance. Valid values:
db: shard node.
mongos: mongos node.
cs: Configserver node
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中待重启节点的类型。取值：
db：Shard节点。
mongos：Mongos节点。
cs：Configserver节点
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to restart mongos nodes in parallel. This parameter takes effect only when multiple mongos nodes are restarted in a batch
parameters.help_zh: 是否并行重启Mongos节点。改参数仅当批量重启Mongos节点时生效
parameters.name: parallel_restart_mongos
